## Causes

Attribution: a team-game counts under a cause when a combination with the fewest causes
that includes it makes the team-game match; "alone" when the cause by itself does, and
"another combination also matches" when a different combination of the same size does too.
Effect: the cause's adjustment applied alone to every team-game, adjusted value minus
unadjusted, on the side it adjusts: this repository's, or the other's for an undone repair.

### Rush attempts nflverse files without the run flag, in scrimmage EPA (`unflagged_rush_attempt_epa`)

- There: A rush attempt without the run flag is a designed run (designed_carries) but no scrimmage snap (scrimmage_snap_expr needs the run flag), so its EPA is not in offensive_epa.
- Here: It is a carry, as there, so its EPA is in rush_epa_sum; like there, it is no offensive snap (pbp.py, "a rush attempt nflverse files without rush is a carry but not an offensive snap").
- Adjustment: Clear rush_attempt on this repository's carries that lack the run flag, so they leave the carries, then re-aggregate (applied before the other adjustments add plays to the carries).
- Team-games it explains (alone or with another cause): 55; games: 55; seasons: 2000-2009, 2011-2017, 2019-2021, 2023-2025.

### Kneel-downs and spikes in scrimmage EPA (`kneels_and_spikes`)

- There: offensive_epa sums EPA over every scrimmage snap, kneel-downs and spikes included (its open question whether they should leave the team ratings).
- Here: pass_epa_sum and rush_epa_sum leave kneel-downs out, and spikes unless nflverse files one as a rush attempt, so their sum is scrimmage EPA without them.
- Adjustment: Count a kneel-down as a designed run (run and rush-attempt flags set) and a spike as a dropback, clearing both flags, then re-aggregate.

### Runs a penalty wiped out, in scrimmage EPA (`wiped_out_run_epa`)

- There: A run a penalty wiped out keeps the run flag (rush 1, rush_attempt 0), so it is a scrimmage snap and its EPA is in offensive_epa; it is no designed run.
- Here: It stays an offensive snap but is no carry, since carries start from rush attempts, so its EPA is in neither pass_epa_sum nor rush_epa_sum; kept on purpose when carries took the source's designed-run rule ("penalty-wiped runs leave the rush sums but stay snaps", DECISIONS.md, 0.54.0).
- Adjustment: Set rush_attempt to 1 on plays with rush 1 and rush_attempt 0, then re-aggregate.

### Fumbles counted on scrimmage snaps only (`fumbles_on_scrimmage_snaps`)

- There: fumbles counts plays with fumble set that are scrimmage snaps (its snap definition).
- Here: The box score's fumbles counts every play with fumble set that is not a special-teams play, so a fumble on a play that is neither (no play type, an aborted snap) counts, and a fumble on a fake kick does not; kept on purpose in phase 1 (DECISIONS.md).
- Adjustment: Treat every play that is not a scrimmage snap by its definition (run plays flagged qb_scramble included) as a special-teams play, then re-aggregate.
